tasks.name: code-context-and-delimiters
tasks.evidence: Fenced code precedence, zero-height delimiters, safe generated fences and literal HTML PRE are tested. Top-level indented code with internal blank rows and CRLF Enter now passes both Linux engines. Nested/container code contexts and remaining keyboard semantics are still pending.

tasks.name: common-markdown-and-mapping
tasks.evidence: List hanging indent, physical/task/tab continuations and quote depth/continuity pass on both Linux engines. Table separator scanning shares escape/code context. Inline tokenizer covers escapes, variable-width code, underscore/nested emphasis, strikethrough and inline links. All current projected text and DOM boundaries use explicit row-relative source intervals; native Select All includes hidden prefixes. Full Linux suite and classic regressions passed with explicit Xvfb rendering fallback. Setext titles and closed initial front matter now pass native Linux opening/edit/undo/mode probes. Reference links, autolinks, images, nested/container code and remaining block/unsupported-literal contexts still pending.

tasks.name: enter-tab-and-local-cleanup
tasks.evidence: Tab/Shift+Tab in both modes now covers caret insertion, mixed terminators, selected rows, list descendants and continuations, oriented selection, undo/redo and Escape focus. Native Linux probes and full regression passed under explicit X11. Prose Enter hard-break provenance, local boundary cleanup, recovery persistence and remaining structural/container semantics still pending. The model now validates, rebases and journals explicit automatic-boundary provenance with UTF-16 JSON round trips; EOF inherits the preceding terminator. UI prose generation/cleanup and real recovery persistence remain pending.
